purpose: Define and execute the Book-owned semantic backup set, restore invariants, offline continuity rules, retention semantics, restored-state validation, and preservation-lineage closure while keeping physical backup, storage, restore, and durability execution owned by CORE.

BOOK: offline continuity and deterministic reconnect disposition
CORE: physical checksum and backup integrity verification
generic local persistence and sync primitives
ownership_split.rule: Book MUST NOT implement or self-certify CORE physical durability mechanics. A Book semantic PASS that depends on physical durability requires an admitted CORE receipt.

semantic_backup_set.digest_rule: semantic_set_digest_sha256 is SHA-256 over the deterministic canonical JSON projection excluding the digest field itself.

release_manifest.rule: The manifest freezes semantic release identity. Durable persistence of the manifest remains a CORE responsibility.

exact_match: all semantic component refs and digests
restore_invariants.destructive_restore_rule: Destructive-restore acceptance requires a successful CORE RESTORE receipt marked destructive_drill=true plus exact Book semantic invariant equality.
restore_invariants.failure_rule: Any mismatch fails closed. Book never repairs, normalizes, or silently advances the restored state during verification.

receipt_rules: semantic_set_digest_sha256 must exactly match the Book semantic backup set
RESTORE used for destructive proof must set destructive_drill=true
core_durability_port.non_claim: This profile defines the Book-facing port contract only. No current CORE physical backup/restore provider is claimed by this artifact.

offline_continuity.base_rule: An offline session is anchored to an exact semantic backup-set digest and exact Book source identity.
offline_continuity.safe_reconnect: If reconnect current semantic_set_digest_sha256 equals the offline base digest, the offline delta is eligible for normal admission; canonical mutation rules still apply.
offline_continuity.divergent_reconnect: If reconnect current semantic_set_digest_sha256 differs from the offline base digest, automatic application is forbidden and disposition is RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.

retention_policy.rule: Book defines what remains semantically retrievable; CORE executes and proves physical retention/retrieval.

preservation_receipt_admission.rule: A preservation receipt is Book evidence that semantic completeness and admitted CORE physical verification agreed on the same frozen semantic set.

lineage_closure.rule: Lineage closure records pointers and anchors only. It does not authorize release, publication, distribution, or a future edition.

qualification_requirements: semantic backup set exact completeness and tamper rejection
destructive restore fail-closed behavior for missing/invalid CORE proof
offline exact-base safe disposition and divergent-base reconciliation disposition
no physical backup/storage/restore implementation in the Book module

completion_boundary.blocking_dependency: Qualified CORE.DURABILITY.BOOK_RECOVERY.v1 physical provider and destructive restore evidence

non_claims: This artifact does not claim a CORE physical backup/restore provider exists.
This artifact does not implement physical storage, backup, restore, rollback, sync transport, or retrievability execution.
This artifact does not make BOOK-ENG-009 complete by itself.
This artifact does not make the Book system complete or production certified.
This artifact does not authorize release, publication, distribution, submission, or reentry.
This artifact does not change CURRENT-AUTHORITY-005, SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-007, peer ownership, the frozen 20-phase lifecycle, or PROSE retirement.
